data.one_liner: A customizable bottom navigation bar with smooth animations and dot indicators.
data.what_it_does: Provides a floating or standard bottom navigation bar widget with customizable item colors, spacing, margins, border radius, and dot indicators. It supports smooth transitions and animations when switching between tabs.
use_when: You want a custom bottom navigation bar with dot indicators and smooth animations.
You need a floating bottom navigation bar with configurable shadows and round edges.
avoid_when: You are using complex nested routing systems that require a built-in router navigation integration.
strengths: Highly customizable appearance including border radius, padding, margins, and colors per tab.
Supports smooth transition animations and floating navigation bar layouts.
weaknesses: Limited to bottom navigation bar use cases.
Documentation for advanced routing integration is not provided.
